mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGES SET profileimage=#{profileimage} WHERE userid=#{userid}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, i.profileimage FROM (SELECT m.num,m.NICKNAME, p.* FROM member M, member_PROFILE p WHERE m.NUM=p.MEMBERID) M, (SELECT userid,profileIMAGE FROM MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGES) i WHERE m.num =+ i.userid AND m.num = #{num} ORDER BY i.profileIMAGE asc

select count(*) from MEMBER M,MEMBER_PROFILE p
m.NUM=p.MEMBERID and m.nickname!=#{nickname}
and p.COUNTRY=#{matchingValue.country}
and p.ADDRESS like '%'|| #{matchingValue.address} ||'%'
and p.HEIGHT between #{matchingValue.height.low} and #{matchingValue.height.high}
and p.WEIGHT between #{matchingValue.weight.low} and #{matchingValue.weight.high}
and p.HOBBY like '%'|| #{matchingValue.hobby} ||'%'
and p.MBTI like '%'|| #{matchingValue.mbti} ||'%'
and p.RELIGION like '%'|| #{matchingValue.religion} ||'%'
and p.DRINKING like '%'|| #{matchingValue.drinking} ||'%'
and p.SMOKING like '%'|| #{matchingValue.smoking} ||'%'
and p.GENDER like '%'|| #{matchingValue.gender} ||'%'
and m.nickname like '%'|| #{searchValue} ||'%'
and p.birth BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{period.start}||'01-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{period.finish}||'12-31' ,'YYYY-MM-DD')
